etymology.historical_story: If the token represents the English name Randall, its history belongs to European personal names rather than Malay derivational morphology. Etymonline connects Randall with Randal and an older name containing elements associated with a shield and a wolf. That historical explanation concerns the name; it does not establish a Malay lexical meaning or identify the person intended here. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Randal).
